title: estimates/1: what `features.estimate` measured on one file
description: The file, the polarity and axis it was measured with, the measurements of `run::preview` that are numbers (each with the figures it comes from; their members are those of KEPT in crates/mzlab-ops/src/run/feat/run_estimate.rs and are not listed here) and, only when there are any, the `notices` of the file (crates/mzlab-ops/src/run/feat/lr_note.rs). The same text from the `flow_estimate` of the page and from `flow run`.

polarity.description: 0 when the file did not decide

notices.description: present only when there is a notice; the same items as `notices` of features-notes/1
